page0.text:
She weaves her way through an unnatural darkness.
A desolate night.
While the moonlight shines, she makes her way through the dark hallway and enters a room.

page1.text:
...
This is a room of a random building.
There are about fifty workers here.
Most of them are male, and they are scattered like puppets with their strings severed.
...
She grits her teeth.
It helps that the darkness limits her vision.
The rotten air is from a plant's smell that turned into smoke and filled the air.
"...What is this scent? Can you tell, Archer?"
Opening the door and windows, she asks someone behind her.
There is no one there.
But in the shroud of smoke, a strong presence wavers.
"It must be witch's ointment—the kind made from umbellifers that destroys love."
"That's hemlock, right? Destroys love... Oh, I see. I wonder if the instigator of this has some grudge against men."
"If so, it must be a woman. I don't know what kind of grudge, but it must be deep-rooted to take it out on people even after becoming a Servant."
"Stop mansplaining and open the windows... They're still breathing. At this rate, it doesn't matter whether we call for help now or if they are found in the morning.
Let's leave as soon as we're done here, Archer."
She opens all the windows on one side, treats the people in especially bad condition, and leaves the room.
"...Ugh. I have to take my clothes to the dry cleaner's."
She sniffs her coat.
Though she was careful not to touch things for the most part, the scent of rust still made it onto her.
The room was sealed.
And the floor of that room was covered in the blood that fifty or so people threw up.
The presence behind her takes form.
What appears behind her is a knight in red.
He is Archer, the Servant who was protecting Rin Tohsaka in spirit form.

page2.text:
"So? Are they flowing towards Ryudou Temple?"
"...Yeah. All the life energy that was taken is flowing towards the mountain. The coma incidents happening in Shinto are caused by whoever is at the temple. I don't know about the Master, but such a thing is beyond human power. If there's anyone capable of doing it, it'd be the Servant Caster."
"A witch at Ryudou Temple, huh? ...In that case, we made a blunder last night."

page3.text:
"A blunder...? You mean how we called it a tie with Berserker? I think that was the best possible outcome."
"I don't know about that. If Caster has such a large network, I'm sure she saw last night's battle.
But despite that, we could not defeat Berserker, we let Saber go, and we gave away the scope of our power. What part of all that is good for us?"
His tone is biting and sarcastic.
But Rin does not answer.

page4.text:
It was not a mistake to drive Berserker away and help Saber.
And most importantly...Archer hasn't shown the full scope of his power yet.
Last night...
It is true that the arrow Archer fired stopped Berserker.
But even Rin, his Master, has yet to find out his identity...or the identity of that powerful Noble Phantasm.

page5.text:
"...Rin."
...No, she knows the principle behind it.
It was just a bomb.
He just detonated a bomb called a Noble Phantasm in front of his enemy.
It goes without saying how exceptional it was.
That was a one-time explosion of magical energy, created using the most powerful of illusions, a Noble Phantasm.
Broken Phantasm.
That is what the red knight's deadly Noble Phantasm is called.

page6.text:
"...Rin."
...Though that itself is also strange.
Servants typically only wield one Noble Phantasm, and it is a part of them that they have had in their past life. What kind of Heroic Spirit would destroy such a thing so freely?

page7.text:
"...Rin."
It is not easy to fix a Noble Phantasm that has been destroyed.
It's like committing suicide for a Servant to destroy their own.

page8.text:
"...Rin."
In other words, Archer abandoned his strongest weapon in a situation where he still had six enemies he needed to defeat.
No, more than that, other Servants would faint if they found out he destroyed his own Noble Phantasm. It is their proof as a hero—

page9.text:
"Rin!"
"Oh, what? Sorry, I wasn't listening."
"...I asked what we are going to do. You must be tired from the previous battle, so we should go back and get some rest."
...
Rin clenches her fist in response to Archer's words.

page10.text:
The previous battle...
A large number of skeleton golems wriggling in the hallway.
All of them were destroyed by her own hand.

page11.text:
She didn't need Archer's help and didn't want to expose Archer's abilities over something like that.
More importantly, she felt anger towards enemies who break the rules as a mage and involve innocent people.
That's why she destroyed them.
She beat them without mercy until there was nothing left.
...She did not show any sympathy, even if the bones were someone that could have been alive until just the other day.

page12.text:
...
She did not suffer any wounds from this battle.
Except one.
She fought and kept the nausea from overwhelming her. In exchange, she bit her lip so hard it bled.

page13.text:
"...We're going after Caster. You can still feel her presence, right? We'll get things over with before she escapes to Ryudou Temple."
"What? I'm surprised. Wasn't it your principle to not do things that you don't think you can do?"
"...That's right. I can't do things where I know the outcome.
But that's different. If we go after her right now, I'm sure we'll be able to find some clue, and most of all—"

page14.text:
"...You can't stand without starting a fight, huh?
Good grief. You're letting the easy opponents run loose and going after the hardest opponent to defeat?"
"...Mm. It's fine, let Saber be. We can finish them off at anytime, so we don't have to worry about them.
We don't have to go out of our way if they're not going to do anything. As long as he's hiding at home, I'll let him be."
